trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened and what I did:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate. That release was not healthy in production; the most recent previously healthy version was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rollback**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions.

3. **Verification**: Confirmed post-rollback the service is healthy in all regions, with the error rate back down to 0.2%.

4. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions"), documenting the failure, the rollback, and the restored health. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the health-check failures is investigated.
